description: Today, Oregon Governor Tina Kotek announced her endorsement of State Representative Janelle Bynum in the primary race to take on Lori Chavez-Deremer for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Janelle Bynum for Congress
title: Governor Tina Kotek Endorses Janelle Bynum for Congress in Oregon's 5th Congressional District
